displayName: OCI-AI-DB-011: AI — Vector Index Corruption Attack
description:
Detects corruption or manipulation of vector indexes used in AI similarity search

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_011", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%vector%' AND "value" > 0
